dialogues.speaker: Aloha
dialogues.text: Ah, my dear customer, you really saved my day. Thank you for chasing those Fatui away!

dialogues.speaker: Aloha
dialogues.text: I don't know where those fools came from, but they didn't even bother to threaten me — just stuck their hands straight into my bag! They're robbers, I tell you!

dialogues.speaker: Aloha
dialogues.text: Thank goodness you stepped in! I would've lost so much if not for you... Please, you must accept my thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Aloha
dialogues.text: Ah, yes, I almost forgot to introduce this place. This is the Sunnyshine Alpaca Park, where we showcase gentle Alpacas. There's also a bunch of related toys for sale!

dialogues.speaker: Aloha
dialogues.text: But those goons just scared off my staff and the guests... Now, I gotta go deal with the mess.

dialogues.speaker: Aloha
dialogues.text: If you're interested in visiting the Alpaca Park, please come back tomorrow!
